mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate at 4.94% as of 2011-11-30
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.85 million units signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for durable goods, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1850.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 112.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals deteriorating economic momentum and reduces corporate profitability expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 112.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a synchronized boom in the housing sector, which boosts consumer wealth and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS at 364198.0 and HOUST at 1849.0 as of 2011-11-30
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS indicates persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a robust labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE at 4.6% and PAYEMS at 135106.0 as of 2011-11-30
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (proxied by GDPC1 growth) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression model).
